references.text: Shamgar ben Anat is also mentioned in the Song of Deborah, where his time is described as a period of uncertainty in Israel.
Ehud was also a judge who saved Israel from its enemies, just like Shamgar.
David killed the Philistine Goliath with an unconventional weapon, just as Shamgar used an ox goad against the Philistines.
Samson killed a thousand Philistines with the jawbone of a donkey, an unusual weapon that resembles Shamgar's ox goad.
The Philistines were a constant threat to Israel, and they forbade the Israelites from having blacksmiths to prevent them from making weapons.
The Lord raised up judges who saved Israel from the hand of plunderers, just as Shamgar saved Israel.
